package halfclose

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	lsfNetwork "example.invalid/halfclose/network"
	"example.invalid/halfclose/raw"
	"example.invalid/halfclose/wit"
)

var ErrClosed = net.ErrClosed

func lsfStreamUnsupported() error { return errors.ErrUnsupported }

type lsfStreamError struct{ failure lsfNetwork.StreamError }

func (e *lsfStreamError) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("provider-error:%d", e.failure.Code) }

type OpError struct {
	Op, Net string
	Addr    any
	Err     error
}

func (e *OpError) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v", e.Op, e.Err) }
func (e *OpError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }

type lsfStreamConn struct {
	mu                                               sync.Mutex
	stream                                           *lsfNetwork.Connection
	remote                                           string
	readDeadline, writeDeadline                      time.Time
	readBusy, writeBusy, closing, readEOF, writeShut bool
	closeDone                                        chan struct{}
	closeError                                       error
}

func connection() (*lsfStreamConn, *raw.Connection) {
	wire := &raw.Connection{}
	wire.OnShutdown = func(context.Context, raw.ShutdownMode) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
		return wit.Ok[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.Observation{})
	}
	wire.OnClose = func(context.Context) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
		return wit.Ok[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.Observation{})
	}
	return &lsfStreamConn{stream: lsfNetwork.TestConnection(wire), closeDone: make(chan struct{})}, wire
}

func TestExpiredDeadlineStillHalfCloses(t *testing.T) {
	c, wire := connection()
	var calls atomic.Int32
	wire.OnShutdown = func(ctx context.Context, how raw.ShutdownMode) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
		calls.Add(1)
		if _, ok := ctx.Deadline(); ok || how != raw.ShutdownModeSend {
			t.Error("unexpected shutdown context or mode")
		}
		return wit.Ok[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.Observation{})
	}
	c.writeDeadline = time.Now().Add(-time.Second)
	err := c.CloseWrite()
	if err != nil || calls.Load() != 1 || !c.writeShut || c.writeBusy {
		t.Fatalf("expired-half-close: err=%v calls=%d shut=%t", err, calls.Load(), c.writeShut)
	}
}

func TestFutureDeadlineDoesNotCancelShutdown(t *testing.T) {
	c, wire := connection()
	c.writeDeadline = time.Now().Add(time.Hour)
	wire.OnShutdown = func(ctx context.Context, _ raw.ShutdownMode) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
		if _, ok := ctx.Deadline(); ok {
			t.Error("write deadline incorrectly attached to shutdown")
		}
		return wit.Ok[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.Observation{})
	}
	if err := c.CloseWrite(); err != nil || !c.writeShut || c.writeBusy {
		t.Fatalf("future-half-close: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestHalfClosePreservesClosedAndOverlapRules(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		closed, busy bool
		expected     error
	}{
		{true, false, net.ErrClosed},
		{false, true, errors.ErrUnsupported},
		{true, true, net.ErrClosed},
	} {
		c, wire := connection()
		var calls atomic.Int32
		wire.OnShutdown = func(context.Context, raw.ShutdownMode) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
			calls.Add(1)
			return wit.Ok[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.Observation{})
		}
		c.closing, c.writeBusy = tc.closed, tc.busy
		if err := c.CloseWrite(); !errors.Is(err, tc.expected) || calls.Load() != 0 || c.writeBusy != tc.busy {
			t.Fatalf("half-close-admission: closed=%t busy=%t err=%v calls=%d", tc.closed, tc.busy, err, calls.Load())
		}
	}
}

func TestHalfCloseFailureIsNotReplayed(t *testing.T) {
	c, wire := connection()
	var calls atomic.Int32
	wire.OnShutdown = func(context.Context, raw.ShutdownMode) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
		calls.Add(1)
		return wit.Err[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.StreamError{Code: raw.ErrorCodeUncertain, MayHaveApplied: true})
	}
	err := c.CloseWrite()
	var failure *lsfStreamError
	if !errors.As(err, &failure) || failure.failure.Code != raw.ErrorCodeUncertain ||
		!failure.failure.MayHaveApplied || calls.Load() != 1 || c.writeShut || c.writeBusy {
		t.Fatalf("half-close-uncertain: err=%v calls=%d", err, calls.Load())
	}
}

func TestProviderStopIsNotRelabeledOrRetried(t *testing.T) {
	for _, code := range []uint8{raw.ErrorCodeCancelled, raw.ErrorCodeTimeout} {
		c, wire := connection()
		var calls atomic.Int32
		wire.OnShutdown = func(context.Context, raw.ShutdownMode) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
			calls.Add(1)
			return wit.Err[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.StreamError{Code: code, MayHaveApplied: true})
		}
		err := c.CloseWrite()
		var failure *lsfStreamError
		if !errors.As(err, &failure) || failure.failure.Code != code || !failure.failure.MayHaveApplied ||
			calls.Load() != 1 || c.writeShut || c.writeBusy {
			t.Fatalf("half-close-provider-stop: code=%d err=%v calls=%d", code, err, calls.Load())
		}
	}
}

func TestHalfCloseKeepsWriteOwnerAndReadIndependent(t *testing.T) {
	c, wire := connection()
	readContext, releaseRead, ok := c.stream.TestBorrowRead()
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("read borrow refused")
	}
	defer releaseRead()
	started, finish := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	var calls atomic.Int32
	wire.OnShutdown = func(context.Context, raw.ShutdownMode) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
		calls.Add(1)
		close(started)
		<-finish
		return wit.Ok[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.Observation{})
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- c.CloseWrite() }()
	select {
	case <-started:
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("shutdown not admitted")
	}
	if err := c.CloseWrite(); !errors.Is(err, errors.ErrUnsupported) {
		t.Fatalf("second shutdown admitted: %v", err)
	}
	if err := c.setDeadline(time.Now().Add(time.Second), false, true); !errors.Is(err, errors.ErrUnsupported) {
		t.Fatalf("write deadline rearmed: %v", err)
	}
	select {
	case <-readContext.Done():
		t.Fatal("shutdown cancelled independent read")
	default:
	}
	close(finish)
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		if err != nil || calls.Load() != 1 || c.writeBusy || !c.writeShut {
			t.Fatalf("half-close-retirement: %v calls=%d", err, calls.Load())
		}
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("shutdown did not finish")
	}
}

func TestCloseCancelsAndWaitsForOriginalBorrow(t *testing.T) {
	c, wire := connection()
	c.writeDeadline = time.Now().Add(-time.Second)
	started, cancelled, acknowledge := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	var shutdownCalls, closeCalls atomic.Int32
	wire.OnShutdown = func(ctx context.Context, _ raw.ShutdownMode) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
		shutdownCalls.Add(1)
		close(started)
		<-ctx.Done()
		close(cancelled)
		<-acknowledge
		return wit.Err[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.StreamError{Code: raw.ErrorCodeCancelled, MayHaveApplied: true})
	}
	wire.OnClose = func(context.Context) wit.Result[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError] {
		closeCalls.Add(1)
		return wit.Ok[raw.Observation, raw.StreamError](raw.Observation{})
	}
	shutdownDone, closeDone := make(chan error, 1), make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { shutdownDone <- c.CloseWrite() }()
	select {
	case <-started:
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("shutdown not admitted")
	}
	go func() { closeDone <- c.Close() }()
	select {
	case <-cancelled:
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("close did not cancel original borrow")
	}
	select {
	case err := <-closeDone:
		t.Fatalf("close returned before acknowledgment: %v", err)
	default:
	}
	if closeCalls.Load() != 0 || wire.Drops.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("owner retired before acknowledgment")
	}
	close(acknowledge)
	select {
	case err := <-shutdownDone:
		var failure *lsfStreamError
		if !errors.As(err, &failure) || failure.failure.Code != raw.ErrorCodeCancelled || !failure.failure.MayHaveApplied {
			t.Fatalf("lost shutdown outcome: %v", err)
		}
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("shutdown acknowledgment did not finish")
	}
	select {
	case err := <-closeDone:
		if err != nil || shutdownCalls.Load() != 1 || closeCalls.Load() != 1 || wire.Drops.Load() != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("close custody: err=%v shutdown=%d close=%d drops=%d", err, shutdownCalls.Load(), closeCalls.Load(), wire.Drops.Load())
		}
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("close did not finish")
	}
}

func TestPinnedNativeTCPHalfCloseIgnoresWriteDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	ln, err := net.ListenTCP("tcp4", &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer ln.Close()
	if err = ln.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	client, err := net.DialTCP("tcp4", nil, ln.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer client.Close()
	peer, err := ln.AcceptTCP()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer peer.Close()
	if err = client.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(-time.Second)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := client.Write([]byte("x")); n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, os.ErrDeadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatalf("reference-write-deadline: n=%d err=%v", n, err)
	}
	if err = client.CloseWrite(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reference-half-close: %v", err)
	}
	if err = peer.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := peer.Read(make([]byte, 1)); n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		t.Fatalf("reference-peer-eof: n=%d err=%v", n, err)
	}
	if _, err = peer.Write([]byte("r")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = client.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var b [1]byte
	if n, err := io.ReadFull(client, b[:]); n != 1 || err != nil || b[0] != 'r' {
		t.Fatalf("reference-read-after-half-close: n=%d err=%v", n, err)
	}
	if err = client.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = client.CloseWrite(); !errors.Is(err, net.ErrClosed) {
		t.Fatalf("reference-closed-half-close: %v", err)
	}
}
